goal: Independently review the Phase 3F Godot asset import prototype for asset import viability, scene load correctness, clean smoke output, implementation scope preservation, and readiness for BK manual testing.
forbidden_changes: implementation code changes or rework fixes

asset edits, new generated assets, Godot scene fixes, Godot script fixes, project.godot mutation, collision changes, movement changes, HUD implementation, gameplay expansion, final art approval, production asset approval, or public-release approval
Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion

verify.name: Imported asset files exist
verify.command: test -e game/assets/phase3e/player.png && test -e game/assets/phase3e/player.png.import && test -e game/assets/phase3e/floor_platform.png && test -e game/assets/phase3e/floor_platform.png.import && test -e game/assets/phase3e/obstacle.png && test -e game/assets/phase3e/obstacle.png.import && test -e game/assets/phase3e/goal_marker.png && test -e game/assets/phase3e/goal_marker.png.import

verify.name: Phase 3F implementation records validate
verify.command: npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/work_package.schema.json -d work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-024.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/run.schema.json -d runs/RUN-20260531-007.json

verify.name: Phase 3F QA records validate
verify.command: npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/work_package.schema.json -d work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-025.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/review.schema.json -d reviews/RV-20260531-002.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/run.schema.json -d runs/RUN-20260531-008.json

verify.name: QA did not mutate implementation files
verify.command: git diff -- game/scripts/player.gd game/project.godot scripts schemas agents context research_notes art_notes owner_reviews reviews/RV-20260531-001.json

human_decision_reason: QA can pass technical import and scope review, but BK/Human Creative Owner still needs to perform manual playable review and decide whether the known visual/collision risks are acceptable for the Phase 3 capability gate.
acceptance_criteria: QA independently reviews RUN-20260531-007 and the changed target files without modifying implementation files.
QA verifies the four imported PNG files and four Godot .png.import files exist.
QA verifies clean smoke output and headless main scene execution.
QA verifies main.tscn references the imported assets as Texture2D/Sprite2D while preserving collision nodes and gameplay script scope.
QA records pass, rework, or blocked in reviews/RV-20260531-002.json with actionable issues if needed.
QA does not claim final art approval, production readiness, gameplay expansion approval, or BK manual playable-feel approval.
notes: This Work Package authorizes QA review only. If QA finds defects, it records rework issues instead of editing Godot, art, or implementation artifacts.
